name: lc_mod_barge
note: our canal module "barge", canal and all, taken off the ring on 24 November (the owner: save it as a prefab): a river barge grounded askew: a hideout in its hold, a wheelhouse, a gangplank. Heads east from its anchor (the canal's middle at its entry, on the canal's floor). The module itself still builds: map_build.py module --name barge
